comparison.objective: Measure a pin diameter accurately with a digital caliper, versus set and lock a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-601 requires square metrology contact and low-force jaw closure while holding a pin or caliper; the candidate requires two-tool screw/nut countertorque and cycle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: PR-601 scores dimensional accuracy, angular alignment, gentle contact, and release/rest placement; it does not test a locked adjustable stop.
comparison.reason: Force-controlled measurement is a different tested ability from mechanically locking and functionally verifying an adjustment.
